estimate the cost: Before we start repairing the roof, the builder will come to estimate the cost of the work.
在我們開始修屋頂之前，工人會來估算工程的費用。
be estimated at: Experts say the value of the old painting is estimated at about two million dollars.
專家表示，這幅古畫的價值估計約為兩百萬美元。
a rough estimate: Can you give me a rough estimate of how long it will take to fix my laptop?
你可以給我一個大略的估計，修好我的筆電要花多久時間嗎？
evaluate performance: At the end of each year, managers evaluate performance to decide who will get a pay raise.
每年年底，經理們會評估工作表現，以決定誰能加薪。
evaluate the evidence: The jury must carefully evaluate the evidence before deciding whether the man is guilty or not.
陪審團在決定這名男子是否有罪之前，必須仔細評估證據。
evaluate options: Before choosing a university, you should evaluate options such as cost, location, and the courses offered.
在選擇大學之前，你應該評估各種選擇，例如費用、地點和開設的課程。
evolve into: What started as a small hobby slowly evolved into a successful online business with thousands of customers.
原本只是一個小嗜好，慢慢發展成擁有數千名顧客的成功網路事業。
evolve over time: Languages evolve over time as people create new words and stop using old ones.
語言會隨著時間演變，因為人們創造新詞並停止使用舊詞。
the plan evolved: At first we only wanted a simple picnic, but the plan evolved into a three-day camping trip.
起初我們只想來場簡單的野餐，但計畫逐漸發展成三天的露營之旅。
species evolve: Scientists believe species evolve slowly as they adapt to changes in their environment over millions of years.
科學家相信物種會在數百萬年間適應環境變化而緩慢演化。
exaggerate the danger: Some news reports exaggerate the danger of the virus, which makes people more worried than necessary.
有些新聞報導誇大了這種病毒的危險，讓人們不必要地更加擔心。
exaggerate one's role: In his speech, the manager liked to exaggerate his role in the project, although he had done very little.
經理在演講中喜歡誇大自己在專案中的角色，雖然他其實做得很少。
hard to exaggerate: It is hard to exaggerate how important clean water is for the health of a community.
乾淨的水對一個社區的健康有多重要，再怎麼強調都不為過。
exceed expectations: The students' test results exceeded expectations, so the teacher rewarded them with a pizza party.
學生的考試成績超出預期，所以老師辦了披薩派對來獎勵他們。
exceed the speed limit: Drivers who exceed the speed limit near schools will have to pay a large fine.
在學校附近超速的駕駛人將被處以高額罰款。
exceed the budget: We must not exceed the budget, so please don't spend more than five thousand dollars on decorations.
我們絕不能超出預算，所以裝飾請不要花超過五千元。
exceed one's authority: The guard went too far and exceeded his authority when he searched the students' bags without permission.
那名警衛做得太過分，未經許可搜查學生的書包，已經越權了。
exchange ideas: The online forum allows students from different countries to exchange ideas about protecting the environment.
這個線上論壇讓來自不同國家的學生交流關於保護環境的想法。
exchange greetings: The two neighbors always exchange greetings every morning when they meet at the bus stop.
這兩位鄰居每天早上在公車站碰面時總會互相問候。
exchange glances: When the teacher announced a surprise test, the students exchanged glances nervously across the room.
老師宣布要突擊小考時，學生們在教室裡緊張地互看了一眼。
exchange currency: Before traveling abroad, you can exchange currency at the bank or at the airport.
出國旅行之前，你可以在銀行或機場兌換外幣。
exchange blows: The two drunk men started arguing and soon began to exchange blows outside the bar.
那兩個喝醉的男人開始爭吵，很快就在酒吧外面互毆起來。
excite interest: The museum's new dinosaur exhibition is sure to excite interest among young visitors this summer.
博物館新的恐龍展今年夏天一定會引起年輕參觀者的興趣。
excite curiosity: The strange box left at the door excited curiosity among all the neighbors on our street.
放在門口的那個奇怪箱子引起了我們這條街上所有鄰居的好奇心。
excite controversy: The mayor's plan to cut down the old trees in the park excited controversy across the city.
市長砍掉公園老樹的計畫在全市引發了爭議。
exclude the possibility: The doctors cannot exclude the possibility that the illness was caused by something he ate.
醫生們無法排除這場病是由他吃的東西引起的可能性。
be excluded from school: After cheating on many exams, he was excluded from school permanently and had to find another one.
他在多次考試中作弊後，被學校永久開除，只好另找學校。
exclude someone from a group: It is unkind to exclude someone from a group just because they dress or speak differently.
只因為某人穿著或說話方式不同就把他排除在團體之外，是很不友善的。
exclude tax: The prices on the menu exclude tax, so the final bill will be a little higher.
菜單上的價格不含稅，所以最後的帳單會稍微高一點。
